description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win next move: strongest when they have two or more immediate winning cells (typically an open three on the bottom row), and also when they have three stacked in column 2, 3 or 4 with the cell above empty and I have no win of my own. Single horizontal or diagonal threats, and vertical threats in columns 0, 1, 5, 6, mostly do not fire.
effect: At firing positions forcing it off changes nothing (the block/forced move is still played). Forced high in quiet openings it takes roughly 20-30 points from column 3 and a little from the edges/column 5, moving it to columns 1-2 (or the preferred off-center move).
notes: p1 any must-block F1 0.32; p2/p5 double threat or opp vertical three in cols 2-4 F1 0.733 (P 0.76 R 0.71, AUROC 0.85); adding my double wins (0.70) or diagonal threats in cols 2-4 (0.60) hurt. Col-3 vertical threats at row 3 are borderline (2.5-5). Some misses are diagonal threats and late positions with an empty column; single-legal-move positions are mixed. Simulation share stays ~0.02 for any level tried; most negative values are opponent must-blocks in column 5. Synthesis reaches 17.96 vs dev max 17.49.
